raw_segments.text: Lo, I that pour these draughts for men now dead, call on my father, who yet holds in
Ruth me and mine own arrestees, father, speak.
How shall thy children rule thine halls again?
Homeless we are and sold, and she who sold is she who bore us, and the price she took
is he who joined with her to work thy death, a jisthis, her new lord.
Behold me here brought down to slaves' estate, and far away wanders arrestees, banished from
the wealth that once was thine, the profit of thy care, whereon these revel in a shameful
Father, my prayer is said, tease thine to hear grant that some fair fate bring arrestees
home, and unto me grant these, a purer soul than is my mother's, a more stainless hand.
